Guggenheim has launched its coverage of cancer drug developer Faeth Therapeutics
with a Buy rating and a $70 price target, citing its lead asset, Piktor, which is undergoing studies for endometrial and breast cancer.

Analyst Brad Canino argued that topline data expected later this year from a Phase 2 trial for Piktor in second-line advanced endometrial cancer could de-risk the drug’s profile against HR+ metastatic breast cancer.

“Our physician survey work and proprietary HR+ mBC market model lead us to believe PIKTOR can fill unaddressed gaps in HR+ mBC to generate significant sales,” the analyst added, assuming $1.5B in peak sales for the drug by 2035.

title: Faeth gets new Buy at Guggenheim on lead asset
